work_item: Goal-related bounded projection for ordinary Japanese AskConjunction Core route

scope.route: Engine::execute Intent::AskConjunction for ordinary Japanese two- or three-clause relation queries
scope.selection: Project each relation clause through the existing Store relation index within one revision-matched transaction, then pass clause evaluations to existing Core conjunction handling.
scope.ownership: Store supplies revision-checked derived records. Existing Core owns clause interpretation, condition/proof evaluation, stop behavior, answer construction and adoption; no new decision authority or parser grammar was added.
scope.budget: The request action allowance is divided among clauses; each clause shares its allowance across projection, proof evaluation and out-of-scope diagnosis.
scope.memory_revision: Committed answers and projection budget stops retain the actor-memory revision used by the indexed evaluations.
scope.index_fallback: A missing or stale index is rebuilt from the authenticated loaded current snapshot. That rebuild reads the full snapshot once; if a concurrent writer advances the head during rebuild, the immutable full-snapshot fallback remains.
scope.recovery: Existing Recovery replays the exact retained memory revision and checks current proof validity. B60 does not establish bounded selection for every Recovery or other Core/learning consumer.
